tools.name: analyze_transcript
tools.description: Coach a speech from its text. Returns weak and filler words with firmer alternatives, rhetorical devices, delivery and rhetoric feedback, grammar/vocabulary/coherence scores (1-10) on the Speakeroo rubric, and word-level issues with the excerpt and a fix. Input: 30-1500 words. Text cannot show pace,

tools.name: refine_transcript
tools.description: Rewrite a speech into a clear structure (PREP, STAR, problem-solution, rule of three and others) chosen to fit it. Returns the rewritten sections, the structure with a 1-10 score for how well the original already followed it, a summary of what changed and one delivery tip. Input: 30-1500 words. Shar

tools.name: analyze_speech
tools.description: Analyze a spoken recording: it is transcribed, then returns everything analyze_transcript does plus delivery metrics only audio can give: words per minute, pace, pauses per minute, filler rate, pitch (median and range) and vocal expression, and pacing, pronunciation and engagement scores. Limits: up

tools.name: get_speech_topics
tools.description: Random speech topics to practise with: impromptu, persuasive, informative, presentation, IELTS Speaking Part 1 questions or Part 2 cue cards. Each result links to the full list on speakeroo.app, where every topic opens a timed practice session.

tools.name: how_to_pronounce
tools.description: How to pronounce an English word Speakeroo has a guide for: IPA, a plain respelling, syllables with the stressed one, sound tips, a note on the usual mistake and two example sentences. Links to the guide, where you can record yourself and get a pronunciation check.

tools.name: get_speaking_rubric
tools.description: A four-level speaking rubric teachers use for speaking homework: fluency, pronunciation, vocabulary range and task completion, with a descriptor for every level. Links to the page with a CSV download. analyze_transcript and analyze_speech score on Speakeroo's own 1-10 rubric.

tools.name: list_filler_words
tools.description: The common filler words in spoken English grouped by what they do, and the steps to stop using them. Links to the guide on speakeroo.app, which has a free filler word tracker.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_transcript" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "analyze_transcript" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
